```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../Q3_WebText"))
```

## 3.1 - 3.3 Run the pipeline on a live URL
Change the URL to any page whose robots.txt allows scraping (default: a Wikipedia article).
```{r run, results='hold'}
system2("Rscript", c("webtext.R", "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_language_processing"))
```
```{r figs, out.width="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(file.path("output", c("fig1_top_words.png", "fig2_wordcloud.png",
                                              "fig3_sentence_scores.png", "fig4_textrank_graph.png"))))
```
